method: Bounded first-author exact pinned Spanish Wiktionary proper-name proposal for independent cross-review. baselineCoverage.definition: At least one sourced English meaning or reviewed grammatical reading; not every meaning, usage or possible grammatical interpretation. No morphology-only fallback, untranslated lemma or placeholder counts.

guards: Exact original capitalization, name POS, raw record/sense, English rendering, source labels and capitalized source URL require independent approval before compilation.
No new accepted words, possible answers, daily identity, spelling normalization, name morphology, transliteration or finite verb authority.
Preserve all existing nonproper meanings/proofs for the same normalized spelling; proper-name meaning is a separate sense.
No generic identity-names fallback: only the exact individually selected referents are proposed.
Do not copy old census counts, planetary counts or current political-status assertions from old source text.
Raw grammatical gender is source inventory, not independent gender certification.
Useful named meanings do not imply these proper names are possible answers or standard/exclusive Mexican choices.
Counts are proposed meanings/current-gap candidate spellings, not new compiled coverage.
